basics.name: Samuel Oliveira
basics.label: Ph.D. Student in Reinforcement Learning
basics.summary: Ph.D. student at the RLAI Lab, University of Alberta, supervised by Rupam Mahmood and affiliated with Amii. Interested in continual learning, reinforcement learning, and robot learning.

work.name: UCL, Ilija Bogunovic's Group
work.summary: Investigated the use of diffusion models for Inverse Reinforcement Learning.
highlights: Created a model to learn a reward/guide function from a classifier-guided trajectory-level diffusion model.
Benchmarked the framework against state-of-the-art IRL methods across multiple Gymnasium environments.

work.name: Imperial College London, Tanaka Group
work.summary: Undergraduate thesis and research assistantship on computationally efficient prediction of eczema severity, in collaboration with Dr Rob Moss (University of Melbourne).
highlights: Implemented a framework using Sequential Monte Carlo methods to predict symptom severity in eczema patients.
The framework outputs predictions for each patient in under a second.
Taught a 2-hour tutorial on SMC methods for the entire lab group.

work.name: Goldman Sachs
work.summary: 10-week internship as a Software Engineer in the Technology division.
highlights: Built from scratch a pen-testing framework for a new web app hosted on AWS.

projects.name: Inverse RL using Generative Planning Models in Trajectory Space
projects.summary: MSc thesis on learning reward functions using diffusion models for Inverse Reinforcement Learning.

projects.name: EczemaPF: Real-Time Eczema Severity Prediction
projects.summary: Undergraduate thesis at the Tanaka Group (Imperial College London) on online inference for eczema severity prediction.
